zh.text: 普林斯顿大学位于美国新泽西州普林斯顿市，是一所私立常春藤联盟研究型大学。学校成立于1746年，前身为新泽西学院，1896年正式更名为现名。其提供涵盖人文、社会科学、自然科学及工程学的本科与研究生课程。校园采用住宿学院制，并设有多个学生组织。

en.text: Princeton University is a private Ivy League research university located in Princeton, New Jersey. Founded in 1746 as the College of New Jersey, it officially became a university in 1896. The institution offers undergraduate and graduate programs in the humanities, social sciences, natural sciences, and engineering. Its campus utilizes a residential college system and hosts numerous student organizations.
